definitions.explanation: The act of communicating back and forth, whether through conversation, messages, or correspondence.

examples.japanese: メールのやり{取|と}りが{続|つづ}いている。
{彼|かれ}とのやり{取|と}りは{楽|たの}しい。
{担当者|たんとうしゃ}とやり{取|と}りして{確認|かくにん}します。
examples.english: I'll check by corresponding with the person in charge.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
やり (giving) + {取|と}り (receiving) - the back-and-forth of giving and receiving

ALTERNATE WRITING:
Also written as やりとり (all hiragana) or {遣|や}り{取|と}り

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・メールのやり{取|と}り - email exchange
・やり{取|と}りを{続|つづ}ける - to continue exchanging
・やり{取|と}りをする - to exchange, to interact

RELATED:
・{交換|こうかん} - exchange (more formal)
・{会話|かいわ} - conversation
・{連絡|れんらく} - contact, communication
